res.why: Canon #23/#371: a bare `except: continue` inside the scoring loop removes exactly the cases the benchmark was built to catch. The accuracy then measures the subset that did not fail — a number that goes up as the model gets worse at the hard cases.
res.fix: Count every exception into a separate `n_error` bucket and report score alongside error rate. Never let an exception leave the loop without incrementing a counter.

res.title: Failed samples are dropped before the score is computed
res.why: Canon #23/#371: a bare `except: continue` inside the scoring loop removes exactly the cases the benchmark was built to catch. The accuracy then measures the subset that did not fail — a number that goes up as the model gets worse at the hard cases.
res.fix: Count every exception into a separate `n_error` bucket and report score alongside error rate. Never let an exception leave the loop without incrementing a counter.
